rist_caller.description: Configuration for pushing streams via RIST (Reliable Internet Stream Transport).
Note: stream_id is required in the schema and typically by the endpoint for session identification.

stream_id.description: Unique identifier for the RIST stream session to be initiated.

ip.description: The target IP address to connect to.

port.description: The target port to connect to.

latency_ms.description: Target buffer size/latency for error correction (in milliseconds).

encryption.description: Encryption configuration for the RIST stream.
